title: Locations in Obadiah
note: Whole picture. Few dots: Zarephath in the north, Jerusalem and Beersheba, a cluster in Edom, Ezion Geber in the south. Petra from Wikidata. Teman left out (identification uncertain). Ezion Geber is a check only: the gazetteer puts it on Jezirat Faraun while the map dot is at the head of the gulf; its 13.6 km error suggests the south end (below Petra) may be out by up to about 10 km.
